key_insight: DeepDOSReasoner predicts electronic and phonon density-of-states spectra while enforcing nonnegativity and total-state conservation by construction.
engineering_relevance: Millisecond-scale spectral prediction enables high-throughput screening for electronic, optical, vibrational, and thermodynamic materials properties.
method: Decode spectra from crystal structures using atom-to-energy source attention.
Refine normalized spectra through learned continuity-equation transport.
Recover element-resolved contributions without direct supervision.
evidence_signal: The model led all evaluated metrics for both spectrum types; prospective DFT validation across a screen of 8,106 materials confirmed valence-band gaps in 25 of its top 50 candidates.
watch_item: Physics constraints ensure nonnegative, state-conserving spectra, but do not guarantee accuracy for unfamiliar chemistries; priority candidates still need DFT validation.
paper_title: DeepDOSReasoner: Physics-Grounded Reasoning for Density-of-States Prediction and Materials Discovery
